title: Raspberry-Lemon Cheesecake Bars
description:
“The Easter Cheesecake That Will Get Everyone Hopping!” from Philadelphia (Kraft Foods). Turn your
raspberry-lemon-cheesecake dreams into reality. Fresh raspberries are stirred into these Raspberry-Lemon
Cheesecake Bars to beautiful effect.
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. each zest and juice from 1 lemon
4 pkg. (8 oz. each) PHILADELPHIA Cream Cheese, softened
directions: Line 13x9-inch pan with foil, with ends of foil extending over sides. Combine graham crumbs, 2 Tbsp.
sugar and butter; press onto bottom of prepared pan. Bake 10 min.
Reserve 1/2 cup raspberries and 1 tsp. lemon zest for later use.
